proof: The exact original-P union is decomposed into positive-area convex cells at every x vertex/intersection event; each cell uses original source edge lines.
Clipping each convex cell by x>=cut cannot add a false bridge across a concave source-P gap.
Every noninitial event and open-slab sample prefix is one positive-shared-edge component; weaker point-contact components were checked separately.
Original source line intervals absent from positive-area clipped cell closures are checked explicitly and none occurs for a noninitial prefix.
Cell-edge contact incidence changes only at enumerated vertex/intersection events. Thus connectedness holds throughout every open slab, not only at its midpoint.

priorSingleSectionAxisResults.reasonForDifferentResult: Separated pieces on a cut scanline are connected through the already revealed right-side P region. Single-section monotonicity was stronger than necessary.
